notes: The two infinitive absolutes are treated by what the ASV actually wrote (rule 56): shakhoach has no distinct adverbial word and is unrepresented, while avod takes *surely* and heads on it.
`הָיָה` takes the presentative *it shall be* (rule 21); the ASV writes no complementizer for the frame, so rule 45 has nothing to place.
The `לְ` of hishtachawitha lahem is unrepresented before the bare English object and the suffix takes *them* (rules 40 and 18).
